description: This file defines an abstract base class 'FeatureAndSnippetBase' within the PdfSharp.Quality namespace, providing common functionality for PDF content generation, including page and document management, drawing options, and output utilities. It references external PDFsharp libraries and system drawing components, and contains methods for creating, rendering, and saving PDF documents and images, as well as comparison and visualization features.

classes.name: FeatureAndSnippetBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common PDF generation and rendering functionalities, including page management, drawing options, and output utilities, for features and snippets within the PdfSharp.Quality namespace.

methods.name: BeginPdfDocument
methods.description: Initializes a new PDF document with author info and single page layout.

methods.name: EndPdfDocument
methods.description: Finalizes the current PDF document, saves it to a byte array, and resets page and graphics references.

methods.name: BeginPdfPage
methods.description: Creates a new PDF page with default size and returns the graphics object for drawing.

methods.name: BeginPdfPage
methods.description: Creates a new PDF page with specified size, graphics unit, and direction, and returns the graphics object.

methods.name: GenerateParallelComparisonDocument
methods.description: Creates a PDF comparing two render results side-by-side.

methods.name: GenerateSerialComparisonDocument
methods.description: Creates a PDF with sequential comparison of PDF and image content.

methods.name: DrawPdfToBox
methods.description: Draws PDF bytes as an image into a specified box in the graphics context.

methods.name: DrawImageToBox
methods.description: Draws PNG bytes as an image into a specified box in the graphics context.

methods.name: DrawEmptyBox
methods.description: Draws a red rectangle with a diagonal line as a placeholder for empty content.

methods.name: SaveAndShowFile
methods.description: Saves byte array content to a temporary file and optionally opens it in a viewer.

methods.name: GetFileExtension
methods.description: Determines the file extension based on the byte array reference.

methods.name: SaveAndShowPdfDocument
methods.description: Obsolete method to save and optionally display the current PDF bytes.

methods.name: SaveAndShowPngImage
methods.description: Obsolete method to save and optionally display the current PNG bytes.

methods.name: SaveAndShowComparisonDocument
methods.description: Obsolete method to save and optionally display the comparison bytes.

methods.name: SaveStreamToFile
methods.description: Saves a stream's content to a specified file path.

methods.name: BeginImage
methods.description: Prepares a bitmap and graphics context for drawing images.

methods.name: EndPngImage
methods.description: Finalizes PNG image creation by saving the image bytes.
